📉 Column Definitions
RANK Current Pos Current rank in the popularity list.
RANK+ Rank(Yest) - Rank(Today) Positions changed vs 24h ago.
HEAT Master Score Weighted aggregate of all momentum signals.
ACC Vel(Now) - Vel(1h ago) Acceleration: (Rate of change of speed).
EFF Rank+ / Surge Efficiency: Rank gain per unit of volume.
CONV Upvotes / Mentions Conviction: Sentiment Quality Ratio.
UPVS Raw Count Total upvotes in last 24h.
UPV+ Upv(Now) - Upv(1hr ago) New upvotes gained since Last Scan (1h).
VOL Current Total shares traded in the current session.
VOL(30) 30-Day Mean Average daily trading volume (Baseline).
SRG (Vol / Avg) * 100 Surge: Current volume as % of 30-day Avg.
VEL Rank+(Now) - Rank+(1hr ago) Hourly change in Rank+. (Speeding up vs 1h ago?)
STRK Hourly Streak Streak: Consecutive HOURS sustaining direction.
MNT% % Change Percent change in mentions vs 24h ago.
SQZ Mnt * Surge / log(MCap) Short Squeeze Score (Vol+Chatter/Cap).
RSI Wilder's 14d Relative Strength Index (Momentum Oscillator).
🎨 Color Indicators
RANK White (Standard).
RANK+ Green (Climbing), Red (Falling).
HEAT Red (> 2.0σ), Orange (> 1.5σ), Yellow (> 1σ).
ACC Magenta (Expl. ≥5), Cyan (Fast >0), White (Steady 0), Red (Slow <0).
EFF Green (> 1.0), Yellow (> 0.5), White (> 0.1), Red (< 0)
CONV Gold (> 1.0x), White (Diluted).
UPVS Green (High Activity > 1.5σ).
UPV+ Green (Positive), Red (Negative).
VOL Bold White (Current Session Activity).
VOL(30) Gray (Baseline average volume).
SRG Yellow (Anomaly > 2σ), Green (High > 1σ).
VEL Green (Speeding Up), Red (Slowing).
STRK Bright (3+), Pale (>0), Red (≤ -2/Cold)
MNT% Yellow (> 2σ), Green (> 1σ).
SQZ Cyan (Score > 1.5σ), White (Normal).
RSI Red (Overbought ≥70), Green (Oversold ≤30).
